Package com.kerosene.kfe.audit.adapters.out.persistence

Class KfeAuditLogService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.audit.adapters.out.persistence.KfeAuditLogService
@Service public class KfeAuditLogService extends Object
Persists append-only, hash-chained financial audit events and emits sanitized structured records. Transaction propagation is deliberately controlled by separate caller-transaction and forensic APIs.

    • KfeAuditLogService

      public KfeAuditLogService(KfeAuditLogRepository repository, KfeHashService hashService, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, com.kerosene.common.audit.StructuredAuditLogger auditLogger)
      Creates the append-only audit service with persistence, hashing, serialization, and logging ports.
      Parameters:
      repository - event store and global appender lock
      hashService - payload/event hash implementation
      objectMapper - serializer for sanitized payload content
      auditLogger - structured logger for persisted event metadata

  • Method Details

    • record

      @Transactional public KfeAuditLogEntity record(String eventType, UUID transactionId, UUID walletId, KfeTransactionStatus fromStatus, KfeTransactionStatus toStatus, Map<String,?> redactedPayload)
      Append-only audit event in the caller's transaction.

      Must join the outer submit TX when transactionId points at a row that is not committed yet — Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW would violate financial_audit_log_transaction_id_fkey and surface as a generic client error ("não conseguimos concluir essa solicitação").

      The global audit appender lock is xact-scoped; callers must not call recordInNewTransaction(java.lang.String, java.util.UUID, java.util.UUID, com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.paymentexecution.KfeTransactionStatus, com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.paymentexecution.KfeTransactionStatus, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, ?>) while this lock is held (see settlement-gate path).

    • recordInNewTransaction

      @Transactional(propagation=REQUIRES_NEW) public KfeAuditLogEntity recordInNewTransaction(String eventType, UUID transactionId, UUID walletId, KfeTransactionStatus fromStatus, KfeTransactionStatus toStatus, Map<String,?> redactedPayload)
      Forensic audit in a new transaction (survives outer rollback).

      Only safe when the outer transaction does not already hold GLOBAL_AUDIT_APPENDER. Prefer record(java.lang.String, java.util.UUID, java.util.UUID, com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.paymentexecution.KfeTransactionStatus, com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.paymentexecution.KfeTransactionStatus, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, ?>) from inside submit, or schedule this after the outer TX has released its locks.
